Aleck Bordon Adventure - Tower & Shaft A.summary: Aleck Bordon Adventure: Tower & Shaft Advance is an Adventure game, published by Aruze Corp, which was released in Japan in 2004.

Bomberman Max 2 - Blue Advance.name: Bomberman Max 2: Blue Advance
Bomberman Max 2 - Blue Advance.summary: Bomberman and Max have been shrunk to the size of an ant by the evil Mujie's secret weapon. Work together with max to find and destroy the device before Mujoe can take control of the universe. And so the newest adventures of Bomberman begins!

Chessmaster.name: Chessmaster
Chessmaster.summary: The Best-Selling Computer Chess Game now available on your favorite console! * Choose from 18 opponents with a range of levels and strategies. * Improve your game with a full tutorial mode. * Learn new strategies from over 150 famous recorded games. * 10 chess sets for both classic and just for fun. * Scalable gameplay for chess players of all levels. * 2-player mode via the Game Boy Advance Game Link Cable.

Crazy Taxi - Catch a Ride.name: Crazy Taxi: Catch a Ride
Crazy Taxi - Catch a Ride.summary: Race against the clock as you pick up passengers and white-knuckle it through busy streets and back alleys. And time is money! So get a grip on the wheel and put the pedal to the metal.

Dr. Seuss' The Cat in the Hat.summary: A port of Dr. Seuss’: The Cat in the Hat for Game Boy Advance.
